title: My Family 👨‍👩‍👦
goal: 认识 Mommy, Daddy, Grandma, Joe

steps.en: Hi, Joe! Hello, Joe! It's English time!
Look, Joe! A family. A happy family!
Mommy. Hello, Mommy! Mommy is happy.
Mommy. Hi, Mommy!
steps.zh: 点跟读，Joe 只说 Mommy 也很好。

steps.en: Daddy. Hello, Daddy! Daddy is happy.
Daddy. Hi, Daddy!
Grandma! Hello, Grandma! Grandma loves Joe.
Joe, go to Grandma. Give Grandma a big hug!
I love Grandma. Love you, Grandma!
steps.zh: Joe 可以只模仿 Grandma 或 Love you。

steps.en: Mommy, Daddy, Grandma and Joe. A happy family! Bye-bye!

title: Grandma & Joe 👵
goal: 理解 hug, smile, come here, love

steps.en: Hi, Joe! Hi, Grandma! Are you ready? Let's play!
Joe is at home. Grandma is at home. Grandma sees Joe.
Grandma smiles. Smile, Grandma! Smile, Joe!
Grandma. My Grandma.
Grandma opens her arms. Come here, Joe!
Joe goes to Grandma. Hug Grandma! Big hug!
I love you, Grandma.
steps.zh: 能说 Love you 或 Grandma 都很好。

steps.en: Grandma is happy. Joe is happy. Happy, happy, happy!
High five, Grandma! One, two, three — high five!
Joe loves Grandma. Grandma loves Joe. Bye-bye!

title: My Home 🏠
goal: 理解 home, door, table, chair, bed

steps.en: Hi, Joe! Welcome home! This is Joe's home.
Look! A door. Open the door. Close the door.
Door. Open the door.
Joe, where is the table? Go to the table!
steps.zh: 让 Joe 指或走向桌子。

steps.en: This is a chair. Sit on the chair. Sit down!
Sit down, Joe. Now stand up! Great job!
Look! A bed. Joe's bed. A soft bed.
Bed. My bed.
At night, Joe goes to bed. Good night, home. Good night, Joe.
Door, table, chair, bed. This is Joe's home! Bye-bye!

title: In the Kitchen 🍎
goal: 理解 apple, milk, cup, eat, drink

steps.en: Hi, Joe! Let's go to the kitchen! Yum, yum!
Look! An apple. Red apple. Yummy apple!
Apple. Yummy apple!
Look! Milk. White milk. Yummy milk!
Milk. I like milk.
Look at the cup. A little cup. Drink from the cup.
Joe, take the cup. Drink, drink, drink!
Apple — eat! Milk — drink! Eat and drink.
Yummy! I like it!
Apple, milk and a cup. Yummy! Bye-bye, Joe!

title: Bath & Bedtime 🌙
goal: 理解 bath, wash, pajamas, bed, sleep

steps.en: Hi, Joe! It's bedtime story time. Hello, moon!
Joe takes a bath. Splash, splash, splash!
Bath. Splash, splash!
Wash your hands. Wash, wash, wash!
Pajamas! Joe puts on his pajamas. Soft pajamas.
Pajamas. My pajamas.
Go to bed, Joe. Lie down. Close your eyes.
The room is quiet. Joe is sleepy. Shh... sleepy Joe.
Good night, Grandma. Love you!
Good night, Joe. Sleep tight. See you tomorrow!

title: Family Play Day 🎲
goal: 练习 come, sit, give me, let's play

steps.en: Hi, Joe! Let's play! Grandma, are you ready?
Joe, come here! Come, come, come!
Come here!
Sit down. Stand up. Sit down. Stand up!
Look! A ball. A little ball. Let's play with the ball!
steps.zh: 可换 Joe 喜欢的玩具。

steps.en: Give me the ball, Joe. Thank you!
Here you are!
Grandma gives the ball to Joe. Joe gives the ball to Grandma.
Let's play, Grandma!
We played together! Great playing, Joe! Bye-bye!
Hi, Joe! Today is Joe's Family Day! Hooray!
Where is Grandma? Hello, Grandma!
Hi, Grandma! I love you!
Give Grandma a big hug!
Where is Joe's bed? Bed, bed, bed!
Stand up! Go! Stop! Sit down!
Where is the apple? Yummy apple!
Yummy apple! I like it!
Joe is at home. Grandma is with Joe. Joe smiles. Grandma smiles. They play together. They are happy.
Great week, Joe! Mommy, Daddy, Grandma and Joe — a happy family. See you next week!
